title: Within Dawn
description: A horror mod where entities beyond the world are hunting you.
body:
# About

Within Dawn is a **psychological horror** mod for Minecraft Forge that transforms familiar survival gameplay into an unsettling experience with paranoia, lurking entities. In the night, the world begins to change. Strange sounds echo through the forests, distant figures appear where they shouldn't, and something seems to be watching from beyond the fog. 

There are different types of **entities** they have there own events and hunting ways. They may spawn together to kill you. Check the spoilers for more knowledge on the Entities.

![running](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/583d7d77667f638558c0b6be9395e9d19e56fd65_0.webp)

This mod features _"blinking"_ some entitys may go away if you blink it is triggered by pressing b key on the keaboard. Feeling like _"was it even there?"_ 

Recommended with **dark Shaders**, **low brightness (around 40%)** and **headphones**.

Some spoilers

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Blind: it spawn on both daw and night. Most dangerous, disturbs with player fov, makes eerie sounds. Ignoring him is the best way to survive.

- Skinwalkers: there are currently 2 of them. One is sussteam and suswolf (couldn't get a good name for them). They are there to scare you. Spawning randomly and making sound for as hints. approaching them is not always safe

- Lurker: (Ignore the names there works and names kind of don't match) often spawn near forests and are eager to hunt the player. Only way to stop them is to wait and run else it will kill you. 
  

</details>
